description.en: International 70 km ultramarathon from the archaeological site of Phaistos to Knossos, with a 3x23 km relay and a 140 km cycling event. Organised by the Marathon Runners Association of Crete Ikaros. Start 08:00 at Phaistos, 9-hour time limit.
Night race through Chania with 5 km and 10 km distances and age categories. Start time and registration are still to be announced.
Cross country race in the Keri forest near Gazi, Heraklion: 10.2 km at 08:30, 5 km at 10:00, a 1600 m Keri Mile trail race and a free 1000 m kids race at 11:45.
Backyard ultra in Voritsi, Heraklion: one 6.706 km loop every hour, day and night, until a single runner is left. Start 11:00 in the central square.

Trail run in the hinterland of Inachori, Chania, to the Retzakas waterfall: 24.7 km Challenge at 10:00, 6.8 km Entry at 10:30 and a children's 1450 m trail. Start and finish at the old primary school of Plokamiana.

Nature run in Malles, Lasithi, with 10 km and 5 km races at 10:30 and a 750 m kids race. Organised by the Cultural Association of Malles with the Ierapetra Health Runners Association. Online registration closes 1 February 2027.

name.el: Τρέχω για την Καρδιά του Παιδιού - Fodele Run
name.en: Fodele Run - Run for the Child's Heart

description.en: Charity run in Fodele, Heraklion, in aid of the Panhellenic Association The Heart of the Child: 10.5 km on dirt and asphalt and a 7 km asphalt route. Start times are still to be announced.

name.en: Venizelos Race and Ikaros City Run

description.en: Chania's historic 10 km Venizelos race together with the Ikaros city run, organised by Athletic Club Kydon. Registration details are still to be announced.

Certified half marathon and 5 km in Ierapetra, from Pachia Ammos beach to Minos park, with children's races and a non-competitive family run. Organised by the Ierapetra Health Runners Association. Registration closes 12 March 2027.
International marathon in Chania, held there since 2016, with a 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km race. The marathon starts at 07:00.

Two-day running festival in Rethymno: a 10 km evening run on Saturday 17 April and the 23 km main race on Sunday 18 April from Kalonykti, plus a 5.5 km run or walk, a children's 2 km, a mountain bike ride and a hike.

Historic race of western Crete in Kissamos: a 21.1 km half marathon from the Xotikospilio entrance to the Chrysoskalitissa monastery, a 7.8 km popular race and a free 1.1 km children's route. Registration has not opened yet.
Half marathon, 10 km and 5 km in Arkalochori, Heraklion, with children's races, organised by the Athletic Health Club ATHLISY. The 2027 date is indicative and not yet confirmed by the organiser.
